138namespace std {
139template <> struct hash<sMacAddr> {
140 size_t operator()(const sMacAddr &m) const
141 {
142 uint64_t value_to_hash = 0;
143 for (size_t byte = 0; byte < sizeof(m.oct); byte++) {
144 value_to_hash <<= 8;
145 value_to_hash += m.oct[byte];
146 }
147 return hash<std::uint64_t>()(value_to_hash);
148 }
149};
